Fires single high-caliber rounds that deal <pve 1078 /> <pvp [123] /> precision damage at base.

Deals 67% increased damage to <barrier/>Barrier Champions.

Breaking a <solar/>Solar Elemental Shield or <barrier/>Stunning a Barrier Champion instantly triggers a <solar/>Solar Ignition.

This <solar/>Ignition benefits from Eriana's damage increase against <barrier/>Barrier Champions if it is triggered by breaking their shield.
